title: TopologyArtifactOverlayCompileChoice
description: Clarification choice returned when a topology overlay follow-up is ambiguous.

id.description: Stable choice id to return on a follow-up clarification answer.

description.description: Optional extra context for the choice.

target.description: Graph element represented by this choice, when the choice maps to a single element.

layerId.description: Overlay layer represented by this choice, when the choice maps to an existing layer.

value.description: Service-defined structured value to preserve non-element choices.
